annotations.title: Get full details for one deal

description: Returns the full terms of one deal from an earlier result: setup costs, price-rise terms, what happens after the intro period, the whole-contract total and whether the deal is available at the user's address.

address_label.description: The display_address the user picked from search_addresses, passed back verbatim. Carried into the switch link so the FindBroadband site greets the user with their address instead of asking again.

deal_id.description: The deal_id from a previous find_broadband_deals or check_if_overpaying result.

postcode.description: The user's postcode. With it, availability is checked at their address.

uprn.description: Property identifier (UPRN) from search_addresses. With it, results are for that exact property instead of the whole postcode. An internal reference, not meaningful to the user.

name: get_deal_details

gift.description: Provider incentive shown on the deal card: a gift card / reward, or a switching credit. NOT included in any cost figure. A switching credit (e.g. 'up to £300') only offsets early-termination fees owed to the user's CURRENT provider, so it is worth £0 to someone out of contract. Gift cards are real value but not bill money.

upload_mbps.description: Advertised upload. Left out for satellite (Starlink), whose feed figure is wrong: Ofcom reports Starlink averages about 20 Mbps up.
